status: Local pre-experiment specification, not external preregistration
question: Can historical cross-fitted subject score distributions select a cost-constrained calibration design that reduces future subject coverage shortfall without excessive set size?
rules: All design choices use training-subject out-of-fold predictions only
All final calibration designs use fewer subjects than available in their calibration pool
Calibrator and test subjects are disjoint from every training and cross-fit subject
All policies share random calibration subject and window permutations
No tuning from outer test results
Reproduce exact budgets and include all feasible cost scenarios

sensitivity.temporal_sampling: contiguous per-subject blocks as an additional condition

statistical_scope: Equal weight to test subjects; paired benchmark differences with dependence-aware limitations; no independent-subject count inflation from repetitions
success_interpretation: Assess both improvement and efficiency costs; do not claim new conformal validity, first-ever optimal cluster sampling, or guaranteed journal acceptance
